behavioral_notes.observation: Daily cron 'Gamification: Goal Challenge Check' (ir_cron_check_challenge, code model._cron_update()) starts draft challenges whose start_date<=today, closes inprogress challenges past end_date, then recomputes goals. _update_all runs a raw SQL join of gamification_goal to mail_presence so only goals of users active within SESSION_LIFETIME are refreshed, recomputes the user_domain participant set, generates missing goals and fires periodic chatter reports. None of this scheduling/side-effect logic is visible in metadata.

Goal current value is recomputed by reading the target business model (definition.model_id) live: computation_mode 'count' runs Obj.search_count(domain) and 'sum' runs Obj._read_group(domain, [], ['<field>:sum']); the stored 'domain' (Char) is safe_eval'd with the goal's user injected as `user`, and start_date/end_date are appended as a temporal clause on field_date_id. 'python' mode safe_eval's compute_code expecting a numeric `result`; 'manually' mode only sends reminders. Completeness and reached/failed transitions follow from condition higher/lower. The cross-model query is pure Python, invisible to metadata.

Badges are granted by creating a gamification.badge.user row. challenge._check_challenge_reward _read_group's reached goals per user, and when count==len(line_ids) calls _reward_user -> badge.user.create(...)._send_badge(). create() enforces badge.check_granting()/_can_grant_badge (rule_auth everyone/users/having/nobody + monthly rule_max limit), and _send_badge posts a 'You've earned the X badge' mail.thread notification. Top-3 ranking rewards (reward_first/second/third_id) are computed by _get_topN_users. These authorization and notification side-effects live only in code.

gamification extends res.users with karma (computed/stored), rank_id and gold/silver/bronze badge counts. Writing karma routes through _add_karma_batch, which inserts an append-only gamification.karma.tracking row (old_value/new_value/gain/origin_ref); _compute_karma re-reads the latest tracking via DISTINCT ON SQL and calls _recompute_rank to assign gamification.karma.rank by karma_min thresholds, emailing users on rank change. A monthly cron 'Gamification: Karma tracking consolidation' (model._consolidate_cron) collapses trackings older than two months into one consolidated row. This ledger/leaderboard machinery is what forum/website_slides consume; not derivable from metadata.

No OWL/JS shipped by this module: extract_frontend reports 0 js_files, 0 xml_templates, 0 owl_components/registry_adds/patches; only a single web.assets_backend bundle reference. The gamification UI is plain backend form/list/kanban views (6 form, 8 list, 4 kanban, 6 search); rich progress/leaderboard widgets live in consumer modules (e.g. website_profile).

classification.rationale: gamification is an HR engagement/motivation support tool, not a primary value activity. It produces no product or customer order; it defines goals/challenges over other modules' data, awards badges and maintains a karma/rank ledger to drive workforce motivation. It is consumed as a support service by hr (hr_gamification), survey, sale/crm (gamification_sale_crm) and the website engagement stack (website_profile, forum, website_slides) via karma. This is a value-support configuration (Stabell & Fjeldstad), aligning to APQC 7.0 Develop and Manage Human Capital (reward & recognition / engagement).

standard_capabilities: goal definitions computing count/sum/python over any Odoo model with a domain
recurring challenges (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) auto-assigned by user domain
individual or leaderboard (ranking) visibility with periodic mail reports
badge catalog with grant rules, monthly limits and challenge rewards
karma points ledger, karma ranks and rank-up emails
typical_fits: website/forum reputation via karma and ranks
common_gaps: custom python goal-compute logic beyond count/sum
bespoke reward types other than badges (e.g. monetary/HR rewards)
richer real-time leaderboard UI (shipped only by consumer modules)
